name: 45502 · Springfield, OH
findings: ZIP 45502 (Springfield) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45502 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45502 (Springfield) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
